cass_sales: Heads-up — MarbleSwap wants a migration POC from CompetitorX. Kickoff 11am PT. They need compatibility notes, committed pricing examples, and the security questionnaire before demo.
omar_engineer: They stream via header X-Stream-ID + chunked SSE. We can proxy that in a small adapter. ETA for staging shim ~48h. @lei_se any parity gotchas?
lei_se: CompetitorX injects an invisible system prefix and trims salutations. Plan: surface the prefix as system role, default temp=0.2, add post-process to remove duplicate salutations. I'll create a 20-prompt smoke set.
zane_infra: They require static staging IPs and CIDR allowlist. We can allocate a staging pool but need legal signoff for peer VPN. CC @ada_security.
ada_security: Uploaded SOC2 link and vendor answers draft. POC can use staging keys; production wants FIPS KMS — needs private deployment conversation.
acct_bot: On-demand rate: $0.06 / 1k. Commit 1M/mo -> 20% -> $0.048 /1k. Commit 2.5M -> 33% -> $0.0402 /1k. Dedicated option available (platform fee).
cass_sales: I'll include adapter fee as one-time services line. Please drop links to mapping doc and smoke results here.
omar_engineer: I'll push the shim this afternoon and post the curl snippet for their engs.
lei_se: Draft mapping doc + prompts done — will attach here in an hour.
cass_sales: Thanks all — I'll loop in MarbleSwap CISO after static IPs and security Q answers are confirmed. :+1:
